title: Settings
subtitle: A city at your own pace.

details.idle: Point at a setting, or move to it, to read what it changes.

session.title: Make yourself at home.
session.text: These settings hold until you leave the city. Picture quality reloads the city at the new level.

sections.label: Display
sections.title: The city, in detail
sections.text: How much the city draws and how the air and light sit on it.

fields.label: Picture quality
fields.text: How much of the city is drawn and how finely. Changing it reloads the city at that level.

fields.label: Fog density
fields.text: A veil over the far streets and the building tops; none clears the air.

fields.label: Exposure
fields.text: How bright the scene reads before the night lights add theirs.

fields.label: Crowd
fields.text: How many people walk the streets around you, from none to 2000.

sections.label: Voices
sections.title: Listen to the people
sections.text: Whether the people you talk to speak their lines aloud, and how loud.

fields.label: NPC voices
fields.text: People say their lines aloud as they show. The talk window's voices toggle turns the same setting.

fields.label: Voice volume
fields.text: The loudness of every spoken line, from silent to full.

fields.label: Developer details
fields.text: Where you stand, the files loaded for it and the frame's cost, in the corners of the screen.
